text:
lia: heads-up console alert: spike in fncall schema rejects in prod-eu after strict canary. a few keys hit but billing tokens spiked.

lia: log example:
[2026-04-02T07:11:02Z] validator WARN: expected object 'result' got array; req=r-7b9; key=acct_42; route=prod-eu -> routed_to=variant-1; fallback=degen

samir: confirmed ~4x validation.fail_count starting when strict=true rolled in EU canary.

maya: are those rejects auto-falling back and generating a full downstream invoke (double charge)? @alex

alex: yes. current router treats hard validation rejects as a fallback to degenerate variant and billing counts the fallback as a full invocation, so malformed payloads appear to be double-billed.

katie: console only shows aggregated "invocation errors" and "fallbacks"  ops needs per-route validation error types to triage (missing_field, type_mismatch).

jon: small low-risk change: validator emits headers on reject like `X-RW-Validate: strict` and `X-RW-Validate-Err: missing_field:result`. router reads header and sets `route.fallback_reason` telemetry label. avoids reparsing body.

samir: telemetry: add labels `validation.fail_type` and `routing.decision`. sample 100% failures, 1% successes for payload captures.

maya: policy: should malformed requests count against fncall quota? SDK says yes, billing ops not comfortable.

alex: interim: count them but surface a separate "validation" line item in console and provide appeals for affected customers.

katie: UX: add `last_validation_error` column with redacted sample link and quick filter by `validation.fail_type`. dashboard tile for top offending API keys.

ops-bot: [ALERT] 4950012345 - validation.fail_rate > 0.9% (5m) prod-eu. runbook triggered.

lia: action items: jon -> header+router tag PR (48h); samir -> telemetry + dashboard card (72h); alex -> billing ledger spec (EOW); katie -> UX wireframe (sync Tue). adding to incident tracker.

lia: thanks, will follow up when router/header change lands and we confirm billing delta :thumbsup:
__notes: Single Slack thread string about fncall schema validation rejects causing fallback routing and unexpected billing. Contains logs, small code/header idea, telemetry labels, console UX suggestions, runbook alert, and action items. No title field per agents.md.
